info.name: Webhook Entities
info.description: Webhook payloads sent by as_webhook_update to as_webhook_entities (artsci-departments). Sources: - Articles: artsci-as project (as_webhook_update/ArticleDataExtractor) - People: artsci-people project (as_webhook_update/PersonDataExtractor) - Terms, media report entries: respective source projects Payloads are JSON-encoded and authenticated via an Authorization header token configured in the Key module on the receiving site (key ID: as_webhook_entities_token). The receiving endpoint queues payloads and processes them on cron (or immediately if crontrigger is enabled in settings). IMPORTANT — field_body.value: The article extractor sends body->processed (rendered HTML), not raw stored markup. Drupal media embeds become tags with absolute artsci-as URLs before transmission. as_webhook_entities automatically downloads these images and rewrites the src attributes to local managed file URLs.

header.description: Token configured in Key module on receiving site (as_webhook_entities_token)

request.description: Creates a new article node. All image fields (portrait, landscape, thumbnail, pano) are downloaded from artsci-as and stored as local media entities. Inline tags in field_body.value are also localized.

item.name: Person
item.description: Person payloads originate from the artsci-people project, which also uses as_webhook_update.
